bio: Xavier Becerra (born January 26, 1958) is an American attorney and politician who is the governor-elect of California. He served as the 25th United States secretary of health and human services under President Joe Biden from 2021 to 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, Becerra served from 2017 to 2021 as the 33rd attorney general of California and from 1993 to 2017 as a U.S. representative from California.
offices: Member of the California State Assembly (1990–1992)
Democratic Caucus Chairman of the United States House of Representatives (2013–2017)
Democratic Caucus Vice Chairman of the United States House of Representatives (2009–2013)
